title: ScopeConfirmed
description: A run's scope is confirmed: the repos it may change, fixed for the run until a scope change is approved or the intent is re-signed. GitHub tokens of the run's Jobs cover these repos only (ADR 0018). Topic hotl.run; subject and key: the run id. Producer: Orchestrator. Main consumers: Knowledge graph (scope precedent), agent runtime (token scope).

repos.description: The repos the run may change, new ones included.

created.description: Repos created for this run (RepoCreated) and onboarded before planning.

confirmedBy.description: Who confirmed it; absent when the run confirmed a scope that needed no one.

briefId.description: The brief whose decision confirmed it.
